name: BioXcel Therapeutics, Inc.
addedReason: continued collapse premarket (-14.77%) following its Aug 27 Chapter 11 filing

growth.note: revenue immaterial (IGALMI launch underperformed); company is liquidating via Chapter 11 asset sale to Teva, fundamentals no longer meaningful

nextEarnings.note: reported 2026-05 quarter; company in Chapter 11, further scheduled reporting uncertain

price.note: Delisted from Nasdaq 2026-08-31 over the Chapter 11 filing; began OTC trading as BTAIQ on 2026-09-08. Sources disagree sharply on the current quote (see conflicts) and no reliable reachable print was found; not recorded rather than guessed.

catalysts.headline: Began trading over-the-counter under new symbol BTAIQ following the Nasdaq delisting
Nasdaq notified BioXcel it would delist the stock following the Chapter 11 filing; trading suspended at the open
BioXcel Therapeutics and two subsidiaries filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions; entered an asset sale agreement with Teva Pharmaceuticals as stalking-horse bidder in a court-supervised sale process
catalysts.impact: stock collapsed from ~$0.72 to ~$0.18 over the following sessions

conflicts: Quote for BTAI/BTAIQ: one aggregator shows ~$2.13 (~$66.68M market cap) circa 2026-09-22, another shows $0.107 as of 2026-09-02 - roughly a 20x discrepancy not explained by any known split. Likely stale or mismatched-symbol data following the 2026-09-08 Nasdaq-to-OTC move. Not reconciled (2026-09-23).
notes: Equity holders are typically wiped out or heavily diluted in a Chapter 11 asset sale; these fundamentals describe a company mid-liquidation, not a going concern.
